propositions: Ship identical canonical and hidden bridge status commands that read durable last-pass state and live lock without mutation, with identical parser, options, output, errors, and exits.

Replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer that advances refs/reconciler/last-pass via observed-OID CAS with three bounded attempts, 100/200 ms delays, and loud push failure before releasing lock.

Status verdict precedence is PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN only when both record and live lock are absent; canary adds CRASHED detection using two read-only fence snapshots across the lock-carried lease.

Derive writer and status identity explicitly from REBAR_ENV_ID or stable local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id, treating missing/empty/unreadable .env-id as hard error; preserve LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID, inbound _event_meta, and reconcile workflow reconciler identity unchanged.

Canary transitions from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable status source by default while retaining explicit github-api rollback for one release, fetching refs/reconciler/*, targeting reconciler, and making no canonical heartbeat API query.

Remove duplicate producers and dead baseline fields after semantic and string reference sweeps; update ADR 0094 plus marker/index per current convention, byte-exact help/CLI reference/env-vars registry, and RED-first held-out coverage for all verdicts, exits, identity separation, CAS behavior, detail degradation, and stalled-fence crash detection.
